sovereign_ingot.name: Sovereign Ingot
sovereign_ingot.lore: Still warm. The Forging Offering in the Anvil Court wants it.

sovereign_key.name: Sovereign Key
sovereign_key.lore: Opens the blast door to the Sovereign Forge.

waves.say: The riveters start. Something answers the noise.

onDone.text: The line stops. A Sovereign Ingot lies on the plate, still warm.
The line locks. A blast gate opens onto the stamping gantry.

mechanics.doneText: The gears mesh. The line is aligned.

onDone.text: Hydraulics howl. The lift pad on the lower deck comes alive, and a shutter opens in the Assembly Gallery.

onStep.text: A pressure gauge climbs. One more lever.

mechanics.jam: The control board is locked. The west lever first.

onOpen.text: The forge roars around the ingot. A heavy blast door lifts in the south wall.

mechanics.hint: A cold forge, its crucible empty and waiting for a bar.
mechanics.verb: sets the Sovereign Ingot in the forge and the blast door lifts.

onOpen.text: The blast door to the Sovereign Forge grinds open.

mechanics.hint: A blast door with a keyway cut like a gear.
mechanics.verb: turns the Sovereign Key and the blast door grinds open.

encounters.say: Belts run empty. Something is still working the line.
The anvil rings once, by itself. A cold forge waits in the south.

bosses.name: The Iron Sovereign
bosses.intro: The Iron Sovereign unfolds from the anvil. Smash the three redstone cores on the pillars to cut its power.
bosses.deathText: The Iron Sovereign grinds to a halt and kneels.

shield.breakText: The cores die! The Iron Sovereign is exposed!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Iron Sovereign calls its servants.

pads.text: The lift hauls you up to the upper deck.

completion.intro: The Sovereign Foundry. Align the line, throw the gantry levers, and bring an ingot to the court.
completion.message: The forge cools. The foundry closes shortly.
